performance.verdict: 9 overdue SOW milestones and a 3-day spend blackout bury the CPL win.

findings.text: Spend hit zero on Sep 25–26 (2 confirmed zero-spend days) and Meta is dark; the CPL win of -27.94% is now at risk of reverting with no active delivery.
5 of 9 SOW milestones were due 2026-07-31 and remain incomplete (pre-launch stack test, Como→GHL migration, GBP triage, Meta account & CAPI, landing pages & tracking) — 58 days overdue.
4 further SOW milestones due 2026-08-31 and 2026-09-01 are also unconfirmed complete: Meta reactivation lanes, Search campaigns, LSA verification, and reactivation nurture sequences.
3-day signal (Sep 23–25 vs Sep 20–22): spend collapsed from avg $57.84/day to $13.22/day and leads dropped from avg 15/day to 2.3/day — a confirmed downward break, not noise.
GBP actions fell 62.5% week-over-week and have been zero for the last 3 recorded days (Sep 24–26), while GA4 sessions dropped 48% — organic floor is eroding with no GBP triage completed.

suggestions.text: Identify and clear the spend-stop cause on Meta before any budget move; zero delivery for 2+ days loses auction learning.
suggestions.monday_update: Meta spend confirmed zero on Sep 25–26 with channel_dark flag active; the recent CPL of $5.23 and 85.71% lead surge are both at risk if delivery does not resume. Investigate billing, ad account status, and campaign scheduling within the MDST-WES-AWARE-WHTAPP account (which held 66.7% of 28-day budget at $331.64). Success check: confirmed spend delivery restored and at least 5 leads recorded within 3 days of fix — re-check 2026-09-30.

suggestions.text: Escalate the 5 July-31 SOW blockers to Nacer; no paid channel can be properly attributed without stack test, CAPI, and landing page tracking.
suggestions.monday_update: Five milestones are 58 days overdue (pre-launch stack test, Como→GHL migration, GBP triage, Meta CAPI, landing pages & tracking) and four more due Aug 31–Sep 1 have no confirmed completion event. Without these, the 95 leads recorded in the 28-day window cannot be traced to booked appointments — the Phase 1 proof metric. Escalate to Nacer for immediate status and set hard completion dates. Success check: each milestone has a confirmed done date logged in Monday by 2026-10-04.

suggestions.text: Watch GBP actions: 3 consecutive zero-action days (Sep 24–26) after a 62.5% weekly drop — confirm GBP triage milestone before diagnosing further.
suggestions.monday_update: GBP actions are zero for the last 3 recorded days and down 62.5% week-over-week, coinciding with the GBP triage milestone being overdue since July 31. This may reflect profile suppression or incomplete optimization rather than true organic decline. No paid action is warranted until the GBP triage SOW milestone is confirmed complete. Re-check 2026-10-01 for a 3-day recovery signal.
